journey.name: Train
journey.description: Train holds what there is to train, by pillar: Strength (the program followed, the last session, the exercises and the equipment, with Start session pinned under them), Conditioning (the presets) and Mobility (the flows). The picker under the title moves between them, the bar's Train item reopens the one last shown, and Back from any returns to Today. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Verify that the page is titled "Train", the picker under the title has "Strength" chosen beside "Conditioning" and "Mobility", and "Start session" is pinned at the bottom
Verify that the title and the picker stay where they are while the cards under them change, that "Conditioning" is chosen, and that "Built-in" lists "Tabata" with its length
Tap "Tabata", then "Start workout" in its sheet
Verify that the workout shows "Get ready"; tap "End", then "End workout" in the dialog
Verify that Train is shown again on "Conditioning", with the "Train" tab selected
Tap the "History" tab, then the "Train" tab
Tap "Mobility" and verify that "Before training" lists "Hips and shoulders" with "8:00"
Tap the "Today" tab, then the "Train" tab, and verify that Train reopens on "Mobility"
Tap "Strength" and verify that "Start session" is shown
Tap the "Settings" button in the title bar, verify that Settings opens, and tap "Back"
Verify that the Today tab is shown and selected
